# Security

## Supported versions

Only the latest 0.x release receives fixes. Upgrade before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting on this repository (Security tab, "Report a vulnerability"). Do not open a public issue.

Factcat has a solo maintainer; expect a best-effort response within a week.

## Scope

The app runs locally against your own warehouse with your own credentials. It generates SQL and runs it there; it never sends your data, credentials, or query results anywhere else.
